verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe dots as an always-on cloud agent with its own computer and browser that keeps working while you are away. It uses background agents for parallel work, delegates parts of requests to Work or Codex with an Activity view for inspection, and reaches out with results or prepared fixes for your review. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that multi-step background tasks complete reliably and return for review as described.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review

citations.quote: Your dot is an always-on agent that keeps work moving across your tools and projects. You can keep talking to it while it works, and it reaches out with results or decisions that need you.
your dot lives in the cloud and has its own computer and browser. You can reach it and it can keep working even when your computer is off.
It can use background agents to work on several things in parallel while you keep talking to it.
Your dot can delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex. In the desktop app, open your dot's profile and select Activity to inspect delegated work
ask it to investigate new bug reports in a connected Slack channel and prepare fixes for your review.
